# AGRENES Market

Uganda's farm-fresh produce exporter to the UK. Direct from certified farms (Global G.A.P. + UNBS), air-freighted weekly via 4x Entebbe to Gatwick flights. Serves both retail diaspora customers and B2B restaurants/distributors nationwide.

## About
- Company: Agriculture Environment & Ecosystems Ltd (AGRENES), est. 2014
- Operations: ~12 tonnes/week export; packhouse in Ndeeba Kabowa, Uganda
- Partner network: 1,500+ outgrower farmers
- Certifications: Global G.A.P., HACCP, UNBS

## Policies
- Free UK delivery on orders over 75 GBP
- Pricing tiers: Retail 1-14 units, Bulk 15-25 (10% off), Wholesale 26+ (25% off)
- Payment: Stripe (card)
- Shipping: Evri UK delivery, calculated at checkout by order weight
